connections.name: REPLAY_REQUIRES_STATE_EQUIVALENCE
connections.observation: A replay is informative only when restored predecessor state is equivalent to the intended earlier state.

connections.name: FRESHNESS_IS_A_SUCCESSOR_PERMISSION
connections.observation: A state can remain authentic while becoming inadmissible for the next decision when freshness is externally changed.

connections.name: ADAPTIVE_SUCCESSOR_DEPENDS_ON_COMPLETE_HISTORY
connections.observation: Sequential/adaptive witness selection depends on complete pre-target history; marginal equivalence does not preserve conditional successor behavior.

connections.name: EXTERNAL_ROOT_BREAKS_LOCAL_REPLAY_SYMMETRY
connections.observation: An external freshness root can distinguish stale replay from current state even when local content and signatures remain valid.

connections.name: PAST_EVIDENCE_CAN_CHANGE_ESCALATION
connections.observation: Evidence accumulated in one stage can redirect or block the next escalation step.

edge_survival_design.rewiring_rule: Permute predecessor-successor assignments while preserving node count, field counts, value marginals and local schema statistics as far as feasible.

negative_control: A cryptographically valid replay is not by itself evidence of temporal continuity; local authenticity is explicitly separated from freshness.
epistemic_boundary: Structural connections only; no claim of physical retrocausality or new mathematics.
